plan.notes: Hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official UCSF General Catalog 'Biomedical Sciences (PhD)' page 'Plan of Study Grid' (Core Courses). The catalog page prints no catalog year; retrieval-year stamp applied. UCSF runs on the QUARTER system: seeded as published (6 quarters, Years 1-2), which the pipeline excludes from semester-based plans. Every printed quarter range reconciles exactly at both bounds (12.5-23.5, 10-21, 7.5-18.5, 2-6 x3); Total Units 36-81 matches the seeded lower-bound sum 36.0 exactly. REPEATED ENROLLMENT (kept verbatim per source): BIOMED SCI 215 Laboratory Rotation in Y1 Fall/Winter/Spring (footnote 2: 3 rotations required); BIOMED SCI 216 Supervised Study and BIOMED SCI 221 Seminars in Biomedical Sciences in all 6 quarters (footnote 1: 6 quarters required). Credit ranges use the source's LOWER bound: 215 = 1 (of 1-8), 216 = 1 (of 1-5). Footnote 3: MSTP students are exempt from 225B as a core requirement. Footnote 4: three instances of BIOMED SCI 270 are required OR other basic science minicourses may fulfill the requirement; the grid maps only one instance (Year 1 Spring), kept verbatim. The catalog's Elective Requirement (two minicourses or one full-length course, with an Approved Electives list) is not term-mapped in the grid and is not seeded; documented here. Years 3+ are dissertation research (not term-mapped) and are not sequenced, consistent with the grid's published scope. The catalog grid publishes no prerequisite column; prereq arrays are empty. REPEATED-ENROLLMENT COURSES (coordinator-verified verbatim from the official published plan; allow_repeated_courses set): BIOMED SCI 215 Laboratory Rotation (sems 1-3); BIOMED SCI 216 Supervised Study (sems 1-6).
